newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal seen slightly up, soyoil flat-lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal seen slightly up, soyoil flat-lower.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures were expected to open slightly higher, while soyoil was seen opening steady to slightly lower, traders said.
Soymeal was expected to open $0.50 to $1.00 higher on supply tightness in cash markets and good demand, CBOT traders said.
Soyoil futures were seen steady to 0.05 cent per lb lower, in response to spillover pressure from weakness in world vegetable oil markets.
However, some traders warned that solid gains in soybeans could push prices higher.
